name: Katin

prices.note: Like-for-like item: men's boardshorts (fixed-waist boardshorts and volleys the store files as boardshorts). Whole collection from the public Shopify feed https://katinusa.com/collections/trunks-1/products.json?limit=250: 12 products, 8 kept as adult boardshorts, 0 with a compare-at price above the price (markdowns, excluded), 8 at regular price. Min: BANNER SURF TRUNK $75.00; max: OTG ARCHER SURF TRUNK $79.00. Katin sells its boardshorts as 'surf trunks' (product type Trunks, collection 'trunks'); hybrid trunks excluded. No markdowns. Waterman Trunk ($75) 'traces back to the original surf trunk sewn by Walter Katin in the 1950s' and comes with a banana boat float keychain. Waists 29–40 on all 8, 42 on 2.

notes: katin.com and www.katin.com failed at the proxy (502); the official store is katinusa.com (title 'Katin USA: Quality Surf Apparel & Men's Trunks Since 1954'; meta 'Born in Surfside, CA in 1954'). known_for from the title.

Shipping policy: domestic orders ship from California; free standard shipping on orders of $75 or more in the continental US; international orders through BorderGuru (destinations shown at checkout, none listed), so ships_to is US.
Refund policy: returns and exchanges 'within 30 days of purchase'; $8.00 return shipping fee deducted.
